docs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
docs.text: Find quick answers to the most common questions about ArteryX.

docs.title: Can I trade paid ranks for in-game money?
docs.text:
Yes.

Players are free to trade paid ranks with other players using in-game money, as long as:

  • The owner of the rank agrees to the trade.
  • The price is decided by the seller.
  • No real money is involved.

Note

ArteryX staff are not responsible for player-to-player trades. Always trade carefully.

docs.title: How do I earn money?
docs.text:
There are many ways to earn money, including:

  • Farming
  • Mining
  • Selling items
  • Player Shops
  • Vote Rewards
  • Auction House
  • Custom Features

See the Making Money guide for more information.

docs.title: How do I protect my base?
docs.text:
Use Claim Blocks to create protected land.

Visit the Claim Blocks Guide to learn how to claim and expand your territory.

docs.title: How do I get more Claim Blocks?
docs.text:
You can earn Claim Blocks by:

  • /buyclaim

docs.title: How do I get Crate Keys?
docs.text:
Crate Keys can be obtained through:

  • VoteParty
  • Events
  • Giveaways
  • Special Rewards

docs.title: Can players steal from my claim?
docs.text:
No.

Players cannot break or place blocks inside your claim unless you give them permission.

docs.title: What happens if I get banned?
docs.text:
If you believe your punishment was incorrect, create a support ticket in our Discord.

Do not evade your ban or use alternate accounts.

docs.title: I found a bug. What should I do?
docs.text:
Please report it privately to the staff through Discord.

Players who abuse exploits may receive severe punishments.

docs.title: Can I use mods?
docs.text:
Allowed:

  • OptiFine
  • Sodium
  • Iris
  • Replay Mod
  • Shaders
  • Minimap (without cave mapping)
  • Client-Side Mods

Not Allowed:

  • X-Ray
  • Kill Aura
  • Fly Hacks
  • Reach
  • Auto Mine
  • Any unfair gameplay modifications

docs.title: Can I AFK?
docs.text:
Yes.

AFKing is allowed as long as you are not abusing bugs, exploits, or unauthorized automation.

docs.title: Server Rules
docs.text:
Play fair, respect others, and help keep ArteryX enjoyable for everyone.

Important

Joining ArteryX means you agree to follow all of the rules below. Staff decisions may be made on situations not explicitly listed if required to protect the server.

docs.title: Respect Everyone
docs.text:
• Treat all players and staff with respect.
  • Harassment, discrimination, hate speech, or personal attacks are not allowed.
  • Do not impersonate staff or other players.

docs.title: Fair Gameplay
docs.text:
• Do not exploit bugs or glitches.
  • Report exploits instead of abusing them.
  • Modified clients that provide an unfair advantage are prohibited.

Examples include:

  • X-Ray
  • Kill Aura
  • Reach
  • Auto Crystal
  • Fly Hacks
  • Speed Hacks
  • Freecam
  • Auto Mine
  • Inventory Tweaks that automate gameplay

docs.title: Griefing & Theft
docs.text:
• Respect claims and player builds.
  • Do not intentionally destroy community projects.
  • Scamming players is not allowed.

docs.title: Alternate Accounts
docs.text:
• Using alternate accounts to gain unfair advantages is prohibited.
  • Staff may limit or remove alternate accounts when necessary.

docs.title: Keep Chat Friendly
docs.text:
• No excessive swearing.
  • No hate speech or discrimination.
  • No harassment or bullying.
  • No inappropriate or NSFW content.
  • No political or religious arguments.

docs.title: Spam
docs.text:
Do not:

  • Spam messages.
  • Flood chat.
  • Abuse CAPS.
  • Repeatedly advertise the same message.

docs.title: Advertising
docs.text:
Advertising is prohibited, including:

  • Other Minecraft servers
  • Discord servers
  • Websites
  • Social media intended to recruit players elsewhere

docs.title: Discord Rules
docs.text:
All Minecraft rules also apply inside the Discord server.

Additionally:

  • No ping spam.
  • No inappropriate usernames or profile pictures.
  • Do not abuse tickets.
  • Keep discussions in the correct channels.
  • Follow staff instructions.

docs.title: Economy Rules
docs.text:
The economy is meant to stay fair.

The following are prohibited:

  • Duplication glitches.
  • Exploiting economy bugs.
  • Chargeback fraud.
  • Abuse of AFK or automation systems.

docs.title: PvP Rules
docs.text:
PvP is allowed.

However:

  • Combat logging is prohibited.
  • Exploiting PvP bugs is prohibited.
  • Intentionally crashing players or the server is prohibited.

docs.title: Staff Rules
docs.text:
Staff decisions are final.

If you believe a punishment was incorrect:

  • Stay respectful.
  • Create a Discord ticket.
  • Do not argue publicly.

docs.title: Punishment Guidelines
docs.text:
Offense Typical Punishment Chat Spam Warning → Mute Excessive Swearing Warning → Mute Toxic Behavior Mute / Temporary Ban Advertising Temporary Ban X-Ray / Hacks Permanent Ban Duplication Exploits Permanent Ban Ban Evasion Permanent Ban Chargebacks Permanent Ban Staff Impersonation Temporary Ban Inappropriate Builds Removal + Punishment Exploit Abuse Temporary or Permanent Ban

Note

Punishments may be increased depending on severity or repeated offenses.

docs.text:
Need clarification about a rule?

Contact Staff

docs.title: Claim Blocks
docs.text:
Claim Blocks protect your builds from griefing and unauthorized players.

ArteryX uses GriefPrevention to keep your land safe.

docs.title: Starting Claim Blocks
docs.text:
Every new player starts with:

🟨 1,536 Claim Blocks

This is enough to protect approximately 6 chunks.

docs.title: Where Can I Claim?
docs.text:
Claims can only be created in the:

🌍 Overworld

Claims are not available in other worlds.

docs.title: Minimum Claim Size
docs.text:
Your first claim must be at least:

📏 100 Claim Blocks

This helps keep claims organized across the world.

docs.title: Creating a Claim
docs.text:
Use the Golden Shovel provided by GriefPrevention.

Simply:

  1. Right-click one corner.
  2. Right-click the opposite corner.

Your land is now protected.

docs.title: Managing Claims
docs.text:
The easiest way to manage your claims is:

/claims

This opens a simple menu where you can:

  • View Claims
  • Teleport
  • Resize Claims
  • Manage Trust
  • View Information

docs.title: Buying More Claim Blocks
docs.text:
Need more space?

Purchase additional Claim Blocks using:

/buyclaim

Price:

💰 $300 per Claim Block

docs.title: Trusting Friends
docs.text:
You can allow other players to build inside your claim.

Use:

/trust <player>

You remain the owner and can remove access at any time.

Tip

Claim your base as soon as possible to avoid losing your progress.

docs.title: Custom Features
docs.text: ArteryX adds a collection of quality-of-life features that improve survival without changing the vanilla experience.

docs.title: 🌳 Fast Leaf Decay
docs.text: Leaves decay much faster after breaking a tree, making wood farming quicker.

docs.title: 🏗️ Concrete Cauldron
docs.text: Right-click Concrete Powder on a Water Cauldron to instantly create Concrete.

docs.title: 🌱 Mud Cauldron
docs.text: Right-click Dirt on a Water Cauldron to convert it into Mud.

docs.title: 🟧 Copper Cauldrons
docs.text:
Special cauldrons make working with Copper easier.

  • 🟢 Slime Cauldron → Ages Copper
  • 🍯 Honey Cauldron → Waxes Copper

docs.title: 🐉 Dragon Rewards
docs.text: Every Ender Dragon has a 25% chance to drop an Elytra.

docs.title: 🖼 Better Paintings
docs.text: Scroll through painting variants before placing them.

docs.title: 🖌 Invisible Item Frames
docs.text: Use a Brush on an Item Frame to toggle its visibility.

docs.title: 🤫 Silent Mobs
docs.text:
Rename any mob:

Silence Me

or

silence_me

to permanently silence it.

docs.title: 🧪 XP Bottling
docs.text:
Store your experience using Glass Bottles.

  • Stores 10 Levels
  • Returns 7 Levels when broken
  • Sneak to bottle multiple at once

docs.title: 🪚 Wooden Stonecutter
docs.text: The Stonecutter also works as a Sawmill, allowing more efficient wooden recipes.

docs.title: 📖 Auto Unlock Recipes
docs.text: All crafting recipes are unlocked automatically when you join.

docs.title: 🐺 Transfer Pets
docs.text: Safely transfer ownership of tamed pets to another player.

docs.title: 🐣 Keep Baby Animals Small
docs.text:
Name a baby mob:

Keep Small

Rename it:

Grow

to let it become an adult.

docs.title: 🧱 Mini Blocks
docs.text: Wandering Traders sell decorative Mini Blocks for builders.

docs.title: 💛 Vanilla, But Better
docs.text: Every feature is designed to save time, reduce repetitive tasks, and improve survival while keeping the gameplay feeling close to vanilla Minecraft.

docs.title: Flux Hopper
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers are upgraded hoppers designed to automate your farms and reduce manual work.

They collect nearby drops, transfer items faster than vanilla hoppers, and can send items directly into linked containers.

docs.title: 🔨 Crafting
docs.text:
Craft a Flux Hopper using the recipe below.

📷 Crafting Recipe

docs.title: 📈 Upgrade System
docs.text:
Each Flux Hopper can be upgraded.

Upgradeable stats include:

  • 📦 Transfer Amount
  • 🧲 Suction Radius
  • 🔗 Link Amount
  • 📍 Link Distance

Open the hopper menu after placing it to upgrade these stats.

docs.title: 🔗 Linking Containers
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers can connect directly to nearby storage.

Simply:

  1. Place your Flux Hopper.
  2. Open its menu.
  3. Click Links.
  4. Link nearby chests, barrels, or other containers.

This allows farms to stay fully automated without overflowing.

docs.title: 💰 Farm Automation
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers work perfectly with:

  • 🌾 Crop Farms
  • 🐄 Animal Farms
  • 👾 Forge Spawners
  • 🌳 Tree Farms

Pair them with Sell Wands for a complete automatic farming setup.

docs.title: ⭐ Why Use Flux Hoppers?
docs.text:
Compared to vanilla hoppers, Flux Hoppers offer:

  • Faster item transfer
  • Larger pickup radius
  • Container linking
  • Upgradeable performance
  • Better server performance
  • Cleaner automated farms

docs.title: 💡 Tips
docs.text:
• Upgrade the suction radius first for better collection.
  • Link multiple storage containers before increasing transfer speed.
  • Keep your hopper inside your claim to prevent griefing.

Money Making

Flux Hoppers become incredibly powerful when combined with Forge Spawners and Sell Wands, creating one of the best passive money methods on ArteryX.

docs.title: Making Money
docs.text: Whether you're just starting or building a massive empire, there are plenty of ways to earn money on ArteryX.

docs.title: 🌾 Farming
docs.text:
Build crop farms and sell your harvest using:

  • /shop
  • Sell Wands

The larger your farm, the more money you'll earn.

docs.title: ⛏️ Mining
docs.text:
Explore caves and gather valuable ores.

Sell your resources at:

/shop

or keep them for crafting and progression.

docs.title: 🐄 Mob Farms
docs.text:
Mob farms are one of the best long-term money makers.

Upgrade your farm with:

  • Forge Spawners
  • Flux Hoppers
  • Sell Wands

These three features work together to create a nearly automatic income.

docs.title: ⚡ Flux Hoppers
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers automatically collect nearby drops and move them into linked containers.

Perfect for:

  • Mob Farms
  • Crop Farms
  • Automatic Collection

Less manual work means more profit.

docs.title: 🪄 Sell Wands
docs.text:
Sell Wands instantly sell everything inside a chest.

Simply:

  1. Hold a Sell Wand.
  2. Right-click a container.
  3. Everything is sold instantly.

No moving items. No opening the shop. Just instant money.

docs.title: 🏪 Player Shops
docs.text:
Think your items are worth more than /shop?

Create your own player shop and sell directly to other players.

Popular resources often sell for much higher prices.

docs.title: ⚖️ Auction House
docs.text:
Sell rare or valuable items using:

/ah

The Auction House lets players bid or purchase items from one another.

Perfect for:

  • Rare Gear
  • Enchanted Items
  • Resources
  • Collectibles

docs.title: 📈 Shop Prices
docs.text:
The Server Shop is not completely static.

Some item prices may be:

  • 📈 Buffed
  • 📉 Nerfed

over time to help balance the economy and encourage players to explore different ways of making money.

docs.title: 💡 Best Money Setup
docs.text:
For the highest income, combine:

  • Forge Spawners
  • Flux Hoppers
  • Sell Wands

This creates a fast, efficient, and mostly automatic farming system.

Tip

Don't rely on just one income source. Farming, mining, player shops, and automatic farms together are the fastest way to become wealthy on ArteryX.

docs.title: Seasons
docs.text:
ArteryX features a fully dynamic Season System that changes the world throughout the year.

Each season brings unique weather, lighting, particles, decorations, mob behavior, and exclusive rewards—making survival feel fresh every time you play.

docs.title: 🌎 Seasonal Cycle
docs.text:
The world automatically rotates through four unique seasons.

🌸 Spring

Life returns as nature awakens across the world.

  • Flowers bloom across the landscape
  • Fireflies appear after sunset
  • Bees and passive animals spawn more frequently
  • Pleasant weather
☀️ Summer

Bright days, warm nights, and clear skies.

  • Longest daytime of the year
  • Higher chance of clear weather
  • Shooting stars appear at night
  • Husks replace Zombies
🍂 Autumn

The world transforms with vibrant autumn colours.

  • Falling leaves
  • Leaf litter beneath trees
  • More Foxes and Bats
  • Pumpkin-wearing mobs
❄️ Winter

Snow blankets the world as temperatures drop.

  • Snowfall across the world
  • Cold breath particles
  • Short days and long nights
  • Strays replace Skeletons

docs.title: 🕒 Day & Night Length
docs.text:
Unlike vanilla Minecraft, every season has different daylight hours.

Season Day Night 🌸 Spring Medium Medium ☀️ Summer Long Short 🍂 Autumn Medium Medium ❄️ Winter Short Long

docs.title: ✨ Seasonal Effects
docs.text:
Throughout the year you'll notice:

  • 🍃 Falling Leaves
  • ✨ Fireflies
  • ☄️ Shooting Stars
  • ❄️ Cold Breath
  • 🌳 Seasonal Tree Colors
  • 🍂 Leaf Litter
  • 🌦 Dynamic Weather
  • 🌎 Seasonal Ambience

docs.title: 👾 Seasonal Mobs
docs.text:
Some creatures become more common depending on the current season.

Season Changes 🌸 Spring More Bees & passive mobs ☀️ Summer Husks replace Zombies 🍂 Autumn More Foxes & Bats, Pumpkin mobs ❄️ Winter Strays replace Skeletons

docs.title: 🎁 Seasonal Crates
docs.text:
Every season introduces its own exclusive crate.

At the beginning of each new season, every player receives:

🎁 1 Seasonal Crate Key

Current seasonal crates include:

  • 🌸 Spring Crate
  • ☀️ Summer Crate
  • 🍂 Autumn Crate
  • ❄️ Winter Crate

Each crate contains exclusive seasonal rewards that are only available during that season.

Open them anytime at:

/warp crates

Every season is designed to make ArteryX feel like a brand new world.

They're one of the biggest quality-of-life features on ArteryX.

docs.title: Forge Spawners
docs.text:
Forge Spawners are one of the fastest ways to build fully automated farms and generate a steady income.

Unlike vanilla, every player can eventually obtain and move spawners.

docs.title: 🛒 Getting a Spawner
docs.text: There are two ways to obtain a spawner.

docs.title: ⛏ Mine One
docs.text: Spawners can be mined using a Silk Touch Pickaxe.

docs.title: 💰 Buy One
docs.text:
Purchase any spawner directly using:

/spawner get

Price:

$75,000

docs.title: ⚡ Upgrading Your Farm
docs.text:
Spawners become even more powerful when combined with:

  • ⚙ Flux Hoppers
  • 💸 Sell Wands
  • 📦 Large Storage Systems

This allows you to create completely automated money farms.

docs.title: 📦 Supported Mobs
docs.text:
Most vanilla mob spawners are supported.

Common choices include:

  • Zombie
  • Skeleton
  • Spider
  • Blaze
  • Breeze
  • Cave Spider
  • Pig
  • Cow
  • Chicken
  • Sheep

More mob types may become available through future updates.

docs.title: 💡 Tips
docs.text:
• Place your spawners inside a claimed area.
  • Use Flux Hoppers to automatically collect drops.
  • Use Sell Wands to instantly sell your farm's loot.
  • Upgrade your farm over time for maximum profit.

Best Combo

Forge Spawner + Flux Hopper + Sell Wand = One of the easiest ways to earn money on ArteryX.
